answer: Work-slot deposit burning makes fakes pay per claimed output. Every work slot locks a 50-credit deposit; a rotating jury audits a sample, and fake slots are burned on the spot — a mirror exposing empty hulls. An attacker with 1,000 puppets times 10 slots locks 500,000 credits, each fake slot sinking linearly with no salvage, while honest work passes audit trivially at near zero cost. Over a full planning horizon fakes burn capital slot by slot while real work earns; in an ocean of cheap registrations only staked, audited identities stay afloat, and volume becomes liability.
